scientific_integrity.limitations: The sufficient numerical imbalance cutoff is not proved optimal; the recovery horizon is defined by a unique scalar root; no weighted or other-graph claims.

scientific_integrity.proof_status: Complete analytical proof of sharp norm, unique peak, positivity horizon and asymptotic separation; independent expert verification not performed.

title: Two timescales of transient amplification and positivity recovery on unbalanced bipartite graphs
